messages:
Ivy: Cobalt procurement reached out. They want countersign but insist on PO before we sign, plus a DocuSign flow that includes PO number and billing contact. Also pushed a DPA redline for EU log residency and an HSM clause in the MSA.
Raj: Quick read: HSM warranty is a non-starter for Legal. We should offer an attestation + SOC2 artifacts and replace hard language with 'commercially reasonable efforts'.
Tess: POC team asks for a short performance note so their infra can greenlight the trial. Suggest adding a non-binding POC appendix rather than changing the MSA.
Maya: Finance won't accept Net60. Offer Net30 or 25% prepay + Net30. If they insist on Net60 need RevOps approval and a billing guarantee.
Ivy: They want DocuSign routed: Cobalt legal -> Cobalt CFO -> Cobalt procurement -> Redwood Legal -> Redwood RevOps. Use envelope fields: PO number, billing contact, tax ID. Any objections?
Raj: Fine with that routing. Use redwood-esign@redwood.com for internal recipients. Make sure to strip internal exhibits from the sent package.
Tess: Draft POC appendix: "Trial appendix (informational): p50 < 140ms, p95 < 480ms for seq_len <=1024 on provisioned trial capacity subject to availability. Metrics via Redwood Console. Non-binding for trial period."
Maya: Good. Also request billing contact + PO up front; Finance will hold if missing.
EngBot: Created ticket ENG-9132 to enable eu-west-1 region pin and trial log redaction flags for Cobalt.
Ivy: I'll send Cobalt an updated order form with two billing options (Net30 OR 25% prepay + Net30), attach POC appendix, KMS attestation link, SOC2 link, and confirm DocuSign routing. Asking for PO number and billing contact before countersign.
Raj: I'll prepare the redacted attestation PDF and quick legal reply.
Tess: I'll attach the finalized appendix to the order form before you send.
Maya: I'll flag Finance hold conditions in the email so procurement knows prepay may be required.
Ivy: Sending now. Will update thread once they respond. :)
